messages:
Maria G: Heads-up — during the quarterly access review I spotted ~12 admin bindings with no owner and an unusual usage pattern that looks like a "skeleton key" (long-lived service sessions + cross-project KMS access). We should triage before the next deploy. :rotating_light:
Derek: Can you paste an example IAM principal and the last access? :eyes:
Maria G: Example: svc-data-pump@redwood-prod. Last IAM activity 2026-02-18T21:02Z; KMS decrypts in project-prod-us with repeated calls from a single external IP.
Olivia: Is this from the new data-pipeline rollout? I can check deploy tags but suspect a mis-scoped role.
Raj: looping in sec-bot for correlation with recent alerts.
sec-bot: Alert 1327: unusual KMS decrypt volume for principal svc-data-pump@redwood-prod across projects-prod-us,prod-eu between 2026-02-18T20:45Z-21:15Z. See /alerts/1327
Maria G: Thanks. Quick triage plan: 1) sample access logs for the 12 bindings (Maria/Derek), 2) add temporary deny policy for any ownerless admin role flagged as active (Olivia/Raj), 3) create ownersheet and notify SREs, 4) roll a canary entitlement removal to test app impact (Derek).
Derek: For sampling I ran: ```gcloud logging read "resource.type=generic_node AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail=\"svc-data-pump@redwood-prod\"" --freshness=1d --limit=100``` got repeated decrypt calls. Also CloudTrail: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=Username,AttributeValue=svc-data-pump@redwood-prod` shows cross-account KMS:Encrypt/Decrypt events.
Olivia: I'll open a short-lived support ticket with the infra team to attach the job's deploy tag. If it's the pipeline, we can scope the role to only the job's SA.
Raj: Recommend we also enable request-level audit logs for KMS decrypts in the affected projects and export to secure bucket for forensics. I'll draft the export policy.
Maria G: Owner sheet: https://docs.internal/redwood/security/owner-assignments (please add owners or mark 'needs-owner'). Add a column for 'temp-deny-result'.
Derek: Suggest running a canary removal on one non-critical project first: disable admin bindings for svc-data-pump in prod-staging, monitor errors for 30m, then rollback if >5% failures.
Olivia: I'll schedule the canary for tomorrow 09:30 PT and tag the run. Calendar: https://cal.redwood/slot/984
oncall: FYI I've created a short-lived emergency role to use if the canary breaks: role/repair-ephemeral (expires in 2 hours). Notify me before rolling.
Maria G: Action owners: Maria/Derek = logs+evidence (due EOD), Raj = audit export and KMS log policies (due EOD+1), Olivia = owner outreach + canary schedule, oncall = emergency rollback plan. Minimal comms to affected teams: security@redwood and infra@redwood.
Derek: If we confirm skeleton-key behaviour, recommend immediate entitlement prune + rotating any KMS CMKs used by that principal.
Maria G: Agreed. We'll meet 09:15 PT tomorrow in #eng-security to review canary prechecks and sign off. Agenda in thread. :white_check_mark:
Olivia: I'll post the pre-run checklist in #eng-security 30m before the canary.
sec-bot: Incident evidence bundle created: /evidence/1327-bundle.tar.gz (read-only link expires in 7 days).
Maria G: Thanks everyone — ping me if you find owners that should be reassigned before the canary.
